=== graph-api config ===
"""Application configuration."""

from pydantic import AnyUrl, SecretStr
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    """Environment driven application settings."""

    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=".env", env_file_encoding="utf-8")

    app_name: str = "Knowledge Graph Service"

    neo4j_url: AnyUrl = AnyUrl("bolt://localhost:7688")
    neo4j_user: str = "neo4j"
    neo4j_password: SecretStr
    neo4j_db_name: str = "neo4j"  # application DB

    pythonpath: str = ""
    log_validation_errors: bool = False

    # Tracing settings
    node_ip: str = "localhost"
    tracing_enabled: bool = False
    service_name: str = "graph-api"

    # Vector index settings
    vector_dimensions: int = 4096

    # LLM embedding settings
    llm_api_key: SecretStr = SecretStr("")
    llm_api_url: str = ""
    llm_api_fallback_url: str | None = None
    llm_embedding_model: str = ""

    # Reranker settings
    reranker_base_url: str = ""
    reranker_api_key: SecretStr | None = None
    reranker_model: str = ""


settings = Settings()  # type: ignore[call-arg]

observation.command: cd /workspace && find 02-backend 03-shared-services -maxdepth 3 -name '*.env*' -o -maxdepth 3 -name 'compose*.y*ml' 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== graph-api config ==="; sed -n '1,60p' 02-backend/graph-api/src/graph_api/config.py 2>/dev/null || find 02-backend/graph-api -name config.py
